newsitem.title: UK: UK aerospace stocks firmer ahead of Paris Airshow.
newsitem.headline: UK aerospace stocks firmer ahead of Paris Airshow.

text.p: British aerospace stocks were firmer on Friday as speculation about pending big orders for some companies sparked interest ahead of the Paris Airshow, traders said.
British jet engine maker Rolls Royce Plc was up 6-1/2p to 265-1/2p on volume of 4.6 million shares. The stock hit a new year high at 267p.
British Aerospace Plc, which has a stake in Airbus Industrie, was up 14p at 13.93-1/2 stg, after striking a new year's high at 13.96 stg.
"Some people expect big orders and go short", one analyst said. "This is the usual bet of the City".
The Paris' airshow, the biggest in Europe and due to start on Saturday, was used by many companies to announce major orders, he said.

Elsewhere in the sector, General Electric Co Plc, which supplies electronic equipment for the industry, rose 4p to 373p, while GKN Plc whose subsidiary GKN Westland makes helicopters, firmed 16p to 10.47 stg. Instrument company Smith Industries Plc rose 13-1/2p to 816-1/2p.
